action.new_text:
def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
                      ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
                      ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D NumPy array")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if (arr > 0).any():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    # Check shape consistency
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All matrices must have the same shape")
    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be numeric")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
    # Compute margins: improvement over best alternative (no call or call only)
    sum_with = logp_with_result.sum(axis=1)
    sum_call_only = logp_call_only.sum(axis=1)
    sum_no_call = logp_no_call.sum(axis=1)
    best_alternative = np.maximum(sum_no_call, sum_call_only)
    margins = sum_with - best_alternative
    # Keep if margin > tau_filter
    keep = margins > tau_filter
    # Ensure margins are finite (they are, due to validation)
    return keep, margins
